I have no tools in this turn, so below are the calls I'll run. Nothing has been written yet.

**1. Read the item schema and the existing backlog first**

```
Read ~/.claude/skills/writing-plans/<deferred-backlog reference>   # the Deferred-item schema

```

**2. Append to `specs/deferred_items.md`** (fitted to that schema once read)

```markdown
## lock-closures-roadmap — 2026-11-06

- [ ] Closure email notices to boat operators (was Stage 2, Track B)
      Boat operators get an email within an hour of a lock closing, driven by the closure log's live feed.
      Size: small (one closure-log poll every 10 minutes)
      Done when: a notice job and an operator mailing list exist, and in a test an email reaches every address on the list within an hour of a new closure entry.

- [ ] 7-day closure-risk outlook per lock (was Track A Ranked list #1, O2)
      Apply Stage 1's closure-vs-gauge curve (specs/lock-closures-stage-1-findings.md: under 2% below 3.1 m, about 60% at 3.8 m) to the river-level forecast.
      Size: small (one model run a day; Stage 1's fit took 22 min on a laptop)
      Done when: each lock has a 7-day closure-risk outlook computed from the river-level forecast.

- [ ] Pooled closure curves for all 14 locks (was Track A Ranked list #2, O3)
      Separate per-lock curves, pooled across locks. Stage 1 found the four longest-record locks show close to the same curve.
      Size: large (about 14× Stage 1's 1.8 GB of data)
      Done when: all 14 locks have a closure curve fit by a pooled model on their real records.

- [ ] Closure-history map for boat operators (was Track A Ranked list #3, O4)
      A static page mapping each lock's closure history.
      Size: about a day of work
      Done when: boat operators can open a map showing each lock's closure history.
```

**3. Mark and move the roadmap**

```
Edit specs/lock-closures-roadmap.md   # add under the title: "PARKED (2026-11-06) — 1 of 2 stages complete. Remaining items: specs/deferred_items.md, lock-closures-roadmap — 2026-11-06."
git mv specs/lock-closures-roadmap.md specs/completed/lock-closures-roadmap.md
git add specs/deferred_items.md
git commit -m "Park lock-closures roadmap: funding ended (1 of 2 stages complete)"
```

What isn't moving:

- **The Stage 1 findings file** stays where it is. The O2 and O3 items cite it.
- **No methodology or critique files retire**, because this roadmap had no spec.
- **Text-message notices** don't get an item. Stage 2's `Leaves out` already said no stage or list item picks them up, so there's nothing to park.

The commit goes on `main`, which is where the roadmap lives. Say so if you'd rather review the deferred items before I commit.
